display.title: T2: The Machine Frame
display.subtitle: The chassis of every Thermal machine
description: Thermal Series machines all share one chassis: the §bMachine Frame§r. A
frame plus a function block becomes a Pulverizer, a Smelter, a Furnace, and
Craft a Machine Frame to complete this beat - even the §bInduction Smelter§r
you just built is a frame at heart.
§7Frames are the gateway to the entire Thermal Tier 2 roster.
